description: How colleges admit by school or major and how they say the intended major is reviewed (specs/chances/base-rates.md "Major", major-and-grades.md "Data"). One entry per admitting unit: the university itself (unit_id is its IPEDS id) or a school or major within it ("{unit_id}:{slug}"). Every value is quoted from the college's own page; nothing is inferred, so a unit without a statement has major_considered null. verified_via says whether the page was read or quoted from it in a search result. Checked by scripts/check-major-admission.mts (npm run verify).
